title: PUBLIC WORKS COMMITTEE REPORT relative to implementing immediate mitigation measures and expediting emergency repairs to address flooding at Harry Bridges…
text:
[Council File 25-0712-S1; CD 15]
[Items for which Public Hearings Have Been Held]
PUBLIC WORKS COMMITTEE REPORT relative to implementing immediate mitigation measures and expediting emergency repairs to address flooding at Harry Bridges Boulevard and Alameda Street in Wilmington.
Recommendations for Council action, as initiated by Motion (McOsker - Nazarian):
1. DIRECT the Bureau of Sanitation (BOS), in coordination with the Department of Transportation (DOT), the Bureau of Engineering (BOE), the Emergency Management Department (EMD), and with assistance from the California Department of Transportation (Caltrans), the Los Angeles County Department of Public Works (LACoPW), and Los Angeles County Office of Emergency Management (OEM), to identify and implement immediate mitigation measures, coordinate emergency response efforts, and expedite emergency repairs to address ongoing tidal flooding at Harry Bridges Boulevard and Alameda Street in Wilmington. These conditions threaten public safety and the reliability of critical goods movement routes, particularly as detour routes associated with the Vincent Thomas Bridge closure are formalized pursuant to Council file No. 25-0712.
2. DIRECT the DOT, in coordination with BOS, BOE, and with assistance from EMD, Caltrans, LACoPW, and OEM, to evaluate current and anticipated detour routes and implement necessary measures or emergency repairs to prevent increased truck traffic from being diverted into Wilmington neighborhoods due to flooding or related infrastructure constraints, including appropriate truck routing, traffic management, signage, and other necessary mitigation measures.
Fiscal Impact Statement:
Neither the City Administrative Officer nor the Chief Legislative Analyst has completed a financial analysis of this report.
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted
